stats.metric: WPA = win rate minus average pre-game win probability, in percentage points

wiki.note: Per-level values quoted at levels 1 to 18.

spells.name: Barrier
spells.wiki: Shield 100 to 460 (lv 1 to 18) for 2.5s. Not reduced by Grievous Wounds.

spells.name: Flash
spells.wiki: Blink up to 400 units toward the cursor.

spells.name: Ghost
spells.wiki: 24% to 51% bonus move speed (by level) for 10s, ignores unit collision.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.wiki: 3s channel to an allied turret, minion or ward. Upgrades to Unleashed Teleport at 10:00.

spells.name: Exhaust
spells.wiki: Range 650. Slows the target 40% and cuts their damage dealt 35% for 3s.

spells.name: Heal
spells.wiki: Heals you and the nearest ally 80 to 318 (lv 1 to 18), +30% move speed for 1s. Half healing if healed again within 35s.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.wiki: Removes disables (not airborne, nearsight or suppression) and gives 75% tenacity for 3s.
